Apply & Aid

Creating your future is easy at Terra State! We are an open access college that wants all of our students to be successful and we take the extra steps to make sure you understand your best options.

The first step to getting the education you desire at Terra State is to fill out our free application. No matter who you are or where you come from, you are welcome here.

Financial aid is money to help pay for college and includes grants, work-study, loans, and scholarships. Here at Terra State our goal is to help you navigate your way through the regulations and help you find the best options for you to pay for your education.

### Your future begins today! If you’re ready to get started on your journey towards a successful new career, we’re here to help.

The admissions team at Professional Skills Institute is committed to assisting you throughout the process – whether you’re just beginning to investigate your educational options, or are ready to start the enrollment process.

### Step 1

**Getting Connected**  
Call us at 419.720.6670 or  
[Fill out our contact form](https://proskills.edu/admissions/#)

### Step 2

**Getting to Know You**  
One of our admissions coordinators will speak with you about where you are in the process, your future career goals, and will help you determine if career education is right for you.

### Step 3

**Your Campus Visit**  
Visiting the campus is the best way to determine if PSI is the right fit for you. We’ll provide you with an individual campus tour where you’ll have an opportunity to see the classrooms and labs where you’ll receive your hands-on training. During your visit we’ll cover all the details of your program of interest, student life at PSI, and the support offered through our career services department. You’ll also meet with a financial aid representative who will discuss what educational funding opportunities may be available to you.

Bring your parents, spouse or friends! Your success is important to your loved ones, so we invite them to be a part of the process.

### Admissions Hours

Monday through Thursday: 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM  
Friday: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM  
Saturday: 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Undergraduate Admissions
========================

You want to change the world, and your undergraduate experience should help you achieve that goal. SNU will prepare you professionally, challenge you to think, and encourage you to serve.

Apply to SNU
------------

Fill out our free online application to get started.

Not sure about your college decision yet? That’s okay! Take the first step to apply, and we will help you through the process.

[Start Application](https://www.snu.edu/apply)

![2022.04.09 - StormSurge-11-X5](https://www.snu.edu/hs-fs/hubfs/2022.04.09%20-%20StormSurge-11-X5.jpg?width=2100&height=1704&name=2022.04.09%20-%20StormSurge-11-X5.jpg)

Campus Visit
------------

Our Admissions Team wants to make sure you have a great experience anytime you visit campus. After your campus visit you’ll know more about SNU’s excellent, credentialed teaching faculty, the academic quality of our majors, future job and career preparation, and financial aid and scholarship opportunities.

[Group Visit](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ChMqXfc8vw7srylUe9dANXy5VCYzEOtxcwEtfvkI_JQ/edit)

[Individual Visit](https://www.snu.edu/campus-visit)

[Attend an Event](https://www.snu.edu/events/admissions-event)

Steps for Admission
-------------------

### Application for Admission

**Submit an application for admission to attend Southern Nazarene University.**

### Test Scores

**Submit official ACT or SAT test scores.**\*

*   The ACT request code for SNU is 3384.
*   The SAT request code for SNU is 6036.
*   CLT - Classic Learning Test\* (no exam code)

\*SNU is proud to accept the Classic Learning Test as an alternative to or in addition to the ACT or SAT.  If you would like to share your CLT scores, please do so by selecting Southern Nazarene University from the drop-down menu in your CLT student account. 

\*Test scores are not required for admission but may be required for highest scholarship opportunities.

### Transcript

**Submit an official, sealed High School transcript and transcripts from any college attended.**

*   A 6-semester High School transcript is required for acceptance.
*   A final High School transcript is required for enrollment.

### Deposit

**A $150 deposit is required for enrollment.**

*   For students entering fall semesters (August start dates), deposits are refundable until May 1st.
*   For students entering spring semesters (January start dates), deposits are refundable until December 1st.

[Apply Now](https://www.snu.edu/apply)

[I Have a Few Questions Before I Apply](mailto:admissions@snu.edu)

![snu-finances-icon](https://www.snu.edu/hubfs/snu-finances-icon.png)

### Financial Aid

The majority of our students receive financial aid in the form of scholarships, grants, loans, and work-study opportunities—making tuition costs much lower.

[Learn More](https://www.snu.edu/financial-services/)

![snu-calculator-icon](https://www.snu.edu/hubfs/snu-calculator-icon.png)

### Net Price Calculator

Take the guesswork out of affording college – estimate how much financial aid you might qualify for based on your unique situation.

[Use Calculator](https://www.snu.edu/undergraduate-admissions/net-price-calculator/)

![snu-heart-icon](https://www.snu.edu/hubfs/snu-heart-icon.png)

### SNU Promise

Oklahoma Residents, If you applied for Oklahoma’s Promise…then you may be eligible for a full tuition waiver (worth $25,140/yr) at Southern Nazarene University.

[Get Started](https://www.snu.edu/undergraduate-admissions/snu-promise/)

PURPOSEFULLY DIFFERENT
======================

REFINING CHARACTER. CREATING CULTURE. SERVING CHRIST.
-----------------------------------------------------

![class-icon](https://www.snu.edu/hubfs/class-icon.svg)

15 :1

### STUDENT-FACULTY  
RATIO

![programs-icon](https://www.snu.edu/hubfs/programs-icon.svg)

65 +

### PROGRAMS  
OFFERED

![degree-icon](https://www.snu.edu/hubfs/degree-icon.svg)

### ALUMNI ACROSS  
THE WORLD

Why Choose SNU?
---------------

**Since 1899**, Southern Nazarene University has set the standard for innovative **servant leadership**. Through **service-oriented classrooms** and a vibrant campus community, **17 NCAA Division II athletic programs**, competitive internships, and **job placement**, we lead by example. Located in the heart of Oklahoma City, SNU is 7 miles from downtown OKC, minutes away from all the city has to offer. Through more than **41** **undergraduate degree programs** and **25 graduate degrees**, you’ll experience true integration of faith and learning, bringing the mind of Christ into every profession. Explore SNU. We’re Purposefully Different.

[### CONCURRENT  \
ENROLLMENT](https://www.snu.edu/programs/concurrent-enrollment)
[### TRADITIONAL  \
UNDERGRADUATE](https://www.snu.edu/undergraduate-academic-programs)

DOCTORATE DEGREES](https://www.snu.edu/pgs/graduate-and-doctorate)

Spiritual Life
--------------

**We care about your spiritual life.** At Southern Nazarene University, you'll find an authentic **Christian Community** where students, faculty, and staff are encouraged and equipped to live out their faith in Christ. On campus, this may look like students serving on **mission trips, leading worship in chapel services, and mentoring others in small group Bible studies**, all while growing deeper in their relationship with Christ. For students attending classes online or in the evenings, applying a **Biblical worldview to projects and weekly devotionals** offers the opportunity to live out faith in practical ways. At SNU, **faith-integrated learning** is woven into every aspect of your education, preparing you to bring Christ into your daily life and future plans. Whether on campus or online, you’ll be part of a supportive community that fosters your **spiritual and academic growth.**

### A Sense of Purpose

At Xavier, your education isn't just about getting a degree. Through service learning and immersive experiences, you'll gain the clarity to pursue a fulfilling career.

### A Drive to Serve

The Musketeer spirit is rooted in service. You'll find countless opportunities to volunteer, advocate for social justice and contribute to your community – both locally and globally.
